title: Eleven Marks on One Page
subtitle: 符号与标识 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 符号与标识（语言与思维·符号与标识）
meta: 主题语境：符号与标识（语言与思维·符号与标识）　|　核心词汇：cross　|　正文 328 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cross 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 my teacher ① put a cross beside eleven names in a register, and she said the putting was the whole of the counting. The ② cross, meaning the mark and not the absences, was one stroke wide and stayed that thin; cross, she said, is the only thing in a register that is judged by how little ink it uses.

Every ③ cross on that page had the same slant, and the ④ cross at the end, meaning the one she kept for the last name and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever queried twice. Cross, my mother said, is nine parts slant and one part somebody willing to explain; my teacher said the explaining is the part that fills eleven names.

My grandfather meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the cross was the whole of the lane, meaning the monument and not the mark. The ⑥ cross, meaning the monument and not any of that, is the only thing in a lane that everybody passes and nobody reads; cross, he said, is either something you put or the only word that means both a mark and a monument. She said the monument is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ cross had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the slant. The ⑧ cross of the whole thing, my teacher wrote in May, was one register and thirty years of explaining; cross, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to explain. He said the explaining was never mentioned.

The ⑨ cross I remember is the one at the end, which she put in 1972 and is still described as the thinnest in the school. A ⑩ cross, my mother said in 1974, is the only thing that improves by being explained; every cross, she said, is a monument that has agreed to look like a mark. She said the monument was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 十字形记号；叉号
B. n. 记号（指那个叉号本身，与那些缺席相对）
C. 固定搭配：put a cross beside 在……旁画叉
D. n. 叉号（指那一页上每一个）
E. n. 叉号（指末尾那一个）
F. n. 十字架；十字形纪念碑
G. n. 叉号（指报告里提到的那一个）
H. n. 十字标记（抽象总称）

items.q: put a cross beside eleven names in a register
The cross, meaning the mark and not the absences
the cross was the whole of the lane
the cross had become a line in a report
The cross of the whole thing
A cross, my mother said in 1974

answers.why: put a cross beside 意为“在……旁画叉”，1958 年老师在点名册上十一个名字旁画了叉。
cross 意为“叉号”，指那个叉号本身而不是那些缺席，只有一笔那么宽。
cross 指那一页上每一个叉号，每一个都是同样的斜度。
cross 指末尾那一个（她留给最后一个名字的那一个），是唯一有人追问过两次的。
cross 意为“十字架、十字形纪念碑”，祖父说那座十字纪念碑就是那条小巷的全部，指的是纪念碑而不是那个叉号。
cross 为另一个义项，指十字纪念碑而不是那个叉号，是小巷里人人经过、却无人去读的东西。
cross 意为“叉号”，指报告里提到的那一个，到 1966 年这个叉号成了报告里的一行。
cross 意为“十字标记”，老师五月写道，整件事的十字标记是一本点名册三十年的解释。
cross 意为“十字形记号、叉号”，我记得的是末尾那一个，她 1972 年画的，至今仍被说成全校最细的。
cross 为抽象总称，母亲说一个叉号是唯一会因为被解释而变好的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1958 年老师在点名册上十一个名字旁画了叉，她说画叉才是这整个点名的全部。（put a cross beside）
那个叉号，指的是那个叉号本身而不是那些缺席，只有一笔那么宽，并且一直是那么细。（cross）
那一页上每一个叉号都是同样的斜度。（cross）
末尾那一个叉号，指的是她留给最后一个名字的那一个，是唯一有人追问过两次的。（cross）
祖父说那座十字纪念碑就是那条小巷的全部，指的是纪念碑而不是那个叉号。（cross）
1974 年母亲说，一个叉号是唯一会因为被解释而变好的东西。（cross）
answers: In 1958 my teacher put a cross beside eleven names in a register, and she said the putting was the whole of the counting.
The cross, meaning the mark and not the absences, was one stroke wide and stayed that thin.
Every cross on that page had the same slant.
The cross at the end, meaning the one she kept for the last name and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever queried twice.
My grandfather said the cross was the whole of the lane, meaning the monument and not the mark.
A cross, my mother said in 1974, is the only thing that improves by being explained.
